snippet.description:
ÚLTIMA HORA | Vox estalla contra RTVE y cancela la grabación de Abascal con Jordi Wild

Vox ha roto de manera frontal con Radio Televisión Española (RTVE) y con la productora de La Revuelta tras la polémica suscitada por la entrevista de David Broncano a Santiago Abascal. A través de un contundente comunicado oficial, la formación acusa a la corporación pública y al equipo del programa de no respetar los compromisos y condiciones acordados de forma previa a la participación de su líder.

Las consecuencias del enfrentamiento han provocado un terremoto mediático inmediato: Vox ha decidido suspender la grabación de la entrevista prevista con Jordi Wild en The Wild Project, paralizando su agenda en plataformas de podcast y redes. Analizamos en Negocios TV el cruce de acusaciones, el comunicado íntegro de la formación de Abascal, las críticas dirigidas a Broncano y el impacto político y reputacional que sacude a RTVE.

snippet.title: Inilah 4 momen paling EMOSIONAL saat melawan mantan klub!🤯
snippet.description:
Mencetak gol ke mantan klub sendiri bukan sekadar mencetak gol biasa. Ada cerita, emosi, bahkan dendam di baliknya. Inilah empat pemain yang pernah menghukum mantan tim mereka sendiri, dan nomor satu melakukannya dengan cara yang luar biasa.

Nomor empat, Kylian Mbappé melawan AS Monaco.

Klub yang membesarkannya justru menjadi korban keganasannya. Mbappé berhasil mencetak gol, tetapi dia memilih untuk tidak merayakannya. Tanpa selebrasi, tanpa ekspresi, hanya menunjukkan rasa hormat kepada mantan klubnya.

Nomor tiga, Erling Haaland melawan Borussia Dortmund.

Kembali ke stadion yang dulu menjadi rumahnya, Haaland justru menciptakan mimpi buruk bagi mantan timnya. Dia mencetak gol lewat sebuah tendangan voli yang luar biasa. Namun, bukannya bersorak, Haaland hanya menatap para pendukung Dortmund dengan ekspresi dingin.

Nomor dua, Cristiano Ronaldo melawan Manchester United.

Old Trafford pernah menjadi rumahnya, dan para penggemar masih menganggapnya sebagai legenda. Ketika berhasil mencetak gol lewat sundulan, Ronaldo tidak melakukan selebrasi. Dia hanya menengadah ke langit, seolah ingin menunjukkan bahwa rasa hormatnya kepada United tidak pernah hilang.

Dan nomor satu, Mohamed Salah melawan AS Roma.

Salah pernah berkembang menjadi pemain yang jauh lebih matang bersama Roma. Namun, saat kembali menghadapi mantan klubnya bersama Liverpool, dia justru tampil menggila dan mencetak dua gol luar biasa. Meski begitu, Salah tidak merayakannya. Dia justru mengangkat kedua tangannya, seolah meminta maaf kepada klub yang pernah membantunya berkembang.

Karena terkadang, mencetak gol ke mantan klub sendiri adalah kemenangan yang tidak bisa dirayakan.

snippet.title: [현장] 범행 동기 나왔나?..이 시각 성북경찰서 / SBS 8뉴스
snippet.description:
〈앵커〉

너무 충격적인 사건입니다. 이 사건 수사는 어떻게 되고 있는지, 서울 성북경찰서에 나가있는 취재기자 연결하겠습니다.

이세현 기자, 피의자에 대한 조사는 진행되고 있습니까?

〈기자〉 

경찰은 아직 피의자에 대한 조사를 못했습니다.

범행 이후 만취 상태로 체포된 피의자 A 씨는 오전 내내 '술이 깨지 않는다'는 이유로 경찰 조사에 응하지 않았는데요.

같은 이유로 오후에도 조사가 한차례 취소되기도 됐습니다.

현재는 조사가 가능한 상태지만, A 씨는 진술을 거부하고 있는 걸로 전해졌습니다.

사건의 실마리를 풀기 위한 기초적인 피의자 조사도 아직 되지 않아 경찰도 정확한 범행 동기 파악에 어려움을 겪고 있습니다.


〈앵커〉

범행 동기가 그 아들의 성범죄와 관련이 있을 것 같은데, 짚어준 것처럼 조사가 아직 시작도 안 됐다면 이 동기 부분도 지금으로서는 불명확하겠네요?

네, 아직 보복살인 여부는 확인되지 않았습니다.

snippet.title: Why couldn’t we name David Walliams sooner? #davidwalliams #littlebritain #bgt
snippet.description:
David Walliams has been accused of preying on teenage girls as young as 15, claims he strongly denies. 

It’s after a three-year-long joint investigation between ITV News and the Guardian.

Allegations of inappropriate sexual behaviour were put to the TV star and children’s author in Spring 2026 - but why, only now, are we able to release his name?

We can report that David Walliams tried to block ITN and the Guardian via an ‘injuction’ from reporting the allegations made via the High Court - a move that’s been described as ‘unprecedented’.

David Walliams has denied all allegations against him, including any criminal activity. He says he is ‘not a sexual predator’, has never groomed young women, and insists he has ‘not broken the law’. 

He says claims he targeted teenage girls and young women - and used his celebrity status to coerce or manipulate them to have sex with him - are false.

Episode Info 👇
Show Name - Bokul- বকুল
Full Episode Number - 193

About the Serial:-
--------------------------

    Odity is a young educated woman grown up in an orphanage. Parent-identity-less Odity, by staying in the orphanage and studying, has now become a well-known doctor of the city. For Odity, the orphanage itself is everything; all her salary, every bit of money, she spends in the orphanage. The caretaker of the orphanage house, Kabita Baideu, sometimes says – “Don’t spend all your salary money only in the name of the orphanage, keep something for yourself too.” But Odity does not listen to her words; according to Odity, the orphanage made her into a selfsufficient woman, gave her a new identity, therefore whatever she does now will only be for the orphanage’s development.
 
      There is a famous businessman of the city named Anabil chaliha. He has many businesses, but his main business is buying land at cheap rates and selling it later at higher prices. He has two sons. The elder son, Nibedan, once lost his eyes because of his father’s mistake. From that day, simple and sincere Nibedan was seen differently by his father, who thought him weak and incapable of handling hardship. On the other hand, the younger son, aditya, is completely opposite. A reckless young man. There is a lot’s of love and affection between the two brothers. Though Nibedan cannot see with his own eyes, he sees the world through the vision of his brother. aditya never lets Nibedan feel his blindness — he takes him everywhere, introduces him to every little things, every environment, so that Nibedan never feels different. 

    One day, Anabil Chilha’s eyes fell on the land of the orphanage house. He tried every way to acquire it, but failed again and again. aditya also visited the orphanage and makes unnecessary noise there, and that is how he met Odity. Slowly, conflict between the two escalated. One day, Aditya was injured in an accident and was admitted to the hospital where Odity worked. The responsibility of treatment fell on Odity. At first, she treated him only out of duty, but gradually some small incidents changed her thoughts about Aditya. Their bond moved from enmity towards love. And later she became the daughter in law of Anabil chaliha. 

    Kalyani was the elder daughter-in-law of Anabil chaliha. Born into a Poor family, being an educated girl, she had married Nivedan under certain circumstances. She found it difficult to accept a blind young man as her husband.
